techniques.name: PMAx: An Agentic Framework for AI-Driven Process Mining
techniques.capability_it_enables: Closed-loop agentic (LLM) orchestration for process mining that bridges process semantics and technical implementation while mitigating LLM hallucinations, limited context windows, and privacy concerns
techniques.code_url: Result block states: code and evaluation are available on GitHub at https://github.com/fit-process-mining/PMAx-evaluation (preprint submitted to EMMSAD 2026 tool demonstration).
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code and evaluation are available on GitHub at https://github.com/fit-process-mining/PMAx-evaluation.

techniques.name: Lite-STGNN: Lightweight Spatial-Temporal Graph Neural Network for Long-term Forecasting
techniques.capability_it_enables: Parameter-efficient long-horizon (up to 720 steps) multivariate spatiotemporal forecasting via trend-seasonal decomposition plus learnable low-rank Top-K sparse graph message passing with horizon-wise gating; faster to train than transformer baselines
techniques.code_url: Explicit GitHub repository stated in WebSearch result block: https://github.com/HTMoges/Lite-STGNN ; accepted at ICAART 2026
techniques.verbatim_quote: The source code is available at https://github.com/HTMoges/Lite-STGNN.

techniques.name: Mobile-Agent-v3.5 (GUI-Owl-1.5)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Native multi-platform GUI agent (desktop/mobile/browser) with instruct/thinking variants at 2B-235B; SOTA on 20+ GUI benchmarks (56.5 OSWorld, 71.6 AndroidWorld, 48.4 WebArena) for end-to-end software/app automation
techniques.code_url: Code at https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent/tree/main/Mobile-Agent-v3.5 ; GUI-Owl-1.5 model family released in multiple sizes (2B/4B/8B/32B/235B)
techniques.verbatim_quote: GUI-Owl-1.5 achieves state-of-the-art results on 20+ GUI benchmarks: 56.5 on OSWorld, 71.6 on AndroidWorld, and 48.4 on WebArena for GUI automation; 80.3 on ScreenSpotPro for grounding.

techniques.name: OpAgent: Operator Agent for Web Navigation
techniques.capability_it_enables: Agentic web-navigation framework (Planner/Grounder/Reflector/Summarizer) plus single-model mode for autonomous long-horizon browser task execution; 71.6% resolve rate on WebArena
techniques.code_url: Code at https://github.com/codefuse-ai/OpAgent and models at https://huggingface.co/codefuse-ai/OpAgent
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code is available at https://github.com/codefuse-ai/OpAgent, and models are available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/codefuse-ai/OpAgent.

techniques.name: ColorBrowserAgent
techniques.capability_it_enables: Long-horizon browser GUI agent with human-in-the-loop knowledge adaptation and progressive summarization for robust web automation; 71.2% on WebArena, 47.4% zero-shot transfer on WebChoreArena
techniques.verbatim_quote: ColorBrowserAgent achieves a state-of-the-art success rate of 71.2% on WebArena and maintains 47.4% performance under zero-shot transfer setting on WebChoreArena.

techniques.name: A-RAG: Agentic RAG via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
techniques.capability_it_enables: Agentic RAG exposing keyword_search/semantic_search/chunk_read tools in a ReAct-style loop for adaptive multi-granularity, multi-hop document retrieval; outperforms prior RAG at comparable/lower retrieved tokens
techniques.code_url: Code and evaluation suite are available at https://github.com/Ayanami0730/arag
techniques.verbatim_quote: A-RAG provides three retrieval tools: keyword_search, semantic_search, and chunk_read, enabling the agent to adaptively search and retrieve information across multiple granularities.

techniques.name: LegalGraphRAG: Multi-Agent Graph RAG for Legal Reasoning
techniques.capability_it_enables: Hierarchical legal graph retrieval plus multi-agent (Researcher/Auditor/Adjudicator) verification for reliable evidence-grounded legal/multi-document reasoning
techniques.code_url: The code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG (ACL'26 Main official code)
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG.

techniques.name: Internalized Reasoning for Long-Context Visual Document Understanding
techniques.capability_it_enables: Synthetic thinking-trace pipeline + SFT + low-strength model merging that internalizes page-relevance reasoning for long visual document understanding; Qwen3-VL-32B hits 58.3 MMLongBenchDoc, beating 7x-larger 235B model
techniques.verbatim_quote: The authors release their pipeline for reproducibility and further exploration at https://github.com/lightonai/distilabel/tree/lc_sft_pipelines.
